//==
// # Core logic interfaces
//
// Truth-valued and bit-level algebra: the Boolean operations shared by truth
// values, set-like types, and whole-number representations.

// Supports the Boolean algebra of conjunction, disjunction, and negation.
// Also models set-like union/intersection/complement.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boolean_algebra)
interface ILogical
{
    And(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    Or(a: Self, b: Self): Self;
    Not(x: Self): Self;
}
